## 中文版本说明

### 招投标检查增强

- 废标项检查现在会明确展示并允许切换当前招标文件、投标文件及其来源项目。
- 新增资格条件、评分项覆盖、关键事实一致性和提交前人工自查结果。
- 优化废标风险、符合性矩阵和结果页签的排版，长内容与窄窗口下更易阅读。
- 支持为风险项记录处理状态和可选备注，重新检查时尽量保留已有处理记录。
- Excel 检查结果增加专项检查和处理信息。
- 按产品范围移除报价专项检查与资料问答入口。

### 界面与稳定性

- 完善经典、柔光和暗黑主题适配，修复暗黑模式下表格、标签及表单控件出现浅色背景的问题。
- 修复动态获取模型列表后，下拉框在聚焦状态显示白色块的问题。
- 优化模型列表接口的 401、403、404 错误提示，避免预期配置错误产生冗长的 Electron handler 日志。
- 改进后台检查任务状态恢复和检查结果本地持久化。

## English Release Notes

### Bid Checking Improvements

- Rejection checks now clearly show and allow switching the active tender document, bid document, and source project.
- Added qualification, scoring coverage, key-fact consistency, and manual pre-submission check results.
- Improved the layout of risk findings, compliance matrices, and result tabs for long content and narrower windows.
- Risk items can store a processing status and an optional note, with existing records preserved when matching items are found after a rerun.
- Excel exports now include dedicated check results and processing information.
- Removed quotation-specific checks and the bid-material Q&A entry to keep the workflow focused.

### UI and Reliability

- Improved Classic, Aurora, and Dark theme compatibility, including fixes for light backgrounds on tables, labels, and form controls in Dark mode.
- Fixed a white block appearing on focused model selectors after dynamically loading the model list.
- Added clearer 401, 403, and 404 messages for model-list requests and avoided noisy Electron handler errors for expected configuration failures.
- Improved background check task recovery and local persistence of check results.
